scope: Theorem 3.1 (Rank loss for a single relation addition) of the manuscript “An exponential two-way deterministic state lower bound for one-way liveness” (preprints/An-exponential-two-way-deterministic-state-lower-bound-for-one-way-liveness-September-25-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 129 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 612819217a292910), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF pages 8-9. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. The quote crosses a page break and includes whatever the extraction places there, such as a page number. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let H be a finite set of size h ≥ 2, let m ≥ 0, and let S ⊆ Dm be a submonoid containing 1. Suppose that ϕ : S → RH is a unital 8 surjection and that every permutation of H has a lift in S which is a permutation diagram. If a ∈ S is idempotent and ϕ(a) = IH ∪ {(x, y)}, x, y ∈ H, x ̸= y, then m − rank(a) ≥ L(h).
